in the solution, option 4 is marked as incorrect, kindly throw some light on the same.

for (( i=2,j=10; i<11; i+=2)); do  
    echo $i,$j  
    j+=10  
done

D Narendran

posts.name: Rajya Lakshmi Jampani
posts.cooked:
For arithmetic operations, we should be using (( j+=10 )). When not enclosed in parentheses, j+=10 works as a string concatenation and the output will be

2,10
4,1010
6,101010
....

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
